##Trial 1a


```{r load}
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r 10% sample}

ds <- open_dataset("D:/50_data_demo_mds.parquet")

# get row count (streaming, safe)
n <- ds %>% summarise(n = n()) %>% collect() %>% pull(n)

sample_10 <- ds %>%
  head(floor(1 * n)) %>%
  collect()
```

```{r collect}
sample_10 <- sample_10 %>%
  group_by(recordId) %>%
  mutate(
    time_std = (time - min(time, na.rm=TRUE)) / (max(time, na.rm=TRUE) - min(time, na.rm=TRUE))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    recordId, time_std, F0, F1, F2, F3, age, gender, healthCode,
    recordId_demo, recordId_mds,
    `MDS-UPDRS1.1`, `MDS-UPDRS1.3`, `MDS-UPDRS1.4`,
    `MDS-UPDRS1.5`, `MDS-UPDRS1.7`, `MDS-UPDRS1.8`,
    `MDS-UPDRS2.1`, `MDS-UPDRS2.4`, `MDS-UPDRS2.5`,
    `MDS-UPDRS2.6`, `MDS-UPDRS2.7`, `MDS-UPDRS2.8`,
    `MDS-UPDRS2.9`, `MDS-UPDRS2.10`, `MDS-UPDRS2.12`,
    `MDS-UPDRS2.13`
  ) %>%
  collect()
```

```{r rename}

sample_10 <- sample_10 %>%
  mutate(
    MDS_UPDRS1_total = rowSums(
      across(starts_with("MDS-UPDRS1")),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    MDS_UPDRS2_total = rowSums(
      across(starts_with("MDS-UPDRS2")),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  
  )
```

```{r cleaning}

sample_10 %>%
  select(
    recordId, time, F0, F1, F2, F3, gender, healthCode,
    recordId_demo, recordId_mds, MDS_UPDRS1_total, MDS_UPDRS2_total,
    age)

sample_10$time %>% min()
```


```{r sanity filter}
library(mgcv)


sample_10 <- sample_10 %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender),
    severity1 = as.numeric(MDS_UPDRS1_total),
    severity2 = as.numeric(MDS_UPDRS2_total),
    severity_total = severity1 + severity2,
    time_std = as.numeric(time_std)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(gender),
    !is.na(severity1),
    !is.na(severity2)
  )
```

```{r fit}

library(mgcv)


sample_10 <- sample_10 %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender),
    time_std = as.numeric(scale(time)),
    severity_total = as.numeric(severity_total)
  )

gam_F0 <- bam(
  F0 ~ gender + 
    s(time_std, k = 8, bs = "cr") +      # "cr" = cubic regression spline
    s(severity_total, k = 6, bs = "cr") + 
    ti(time_std, severity_total, k = c(5, 4), bs = "cr") + 
    gender:severity_total,
  data     = sample_10,
  method   = "fREML",
  discrete = TRUE
)
```



##Trial 1b

```{r bam replacement for memory efficiency}


features <- c("F0", "F1", "F2", "F3")

bams <- lapply(features, function(f) {
  bam(
    as.formula(paste0(
      f, " ~ s(time_std, k=8) + ",
      "s(severity_total, k=6) + ",
      "ti(time_std, severity_total, k=c(6,5)) + ",
      "gender + gender:severity_total + ",
      "age"
    )),
    data = sample_10,
    method = "fREML",
    discrete = TRUE
  )
})

names(bams) <- features

```


```{r prep}


library(mgcv)

sample_10 <- sample_10 %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender),
    time_std = as.numeric(scale(time)),
    severity_total = as.numeric(severity_total)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(F0), !is.na(F1), !is.na(F2), !is.na(F3),
    !is.na(time_std), !is.na(severity_total)
  )

```

```{r}

features <- c("F0", "F1", "F2", "F3")

bams <- lapply(features, function(f) {
  message("Fitting BAM for ", f)
  bam(
    as.formula(paste0(
      f, " ~ ",
      "s(time_std, k=8) + ",                     # time smooth
      "s(severity_total, k=6) + ",              # severity smooth
      "ti(time_std, severity_total, k=c(6,5)) + ", # interaction
      "gender + gender:severity_total + ",
      "age" # gender effects
    )),
    data = sample_10,
    method = "fREML",
    discrete = TRUE
  )
})

names(bams) <- features

```

```{r plotting}

# Base plot for F0 BAM
plot(bams$F0, pages = 1, scheme = 2, rug = FALSE)

# Or ggplot with predict()
library(ggplot2)

# Create prediction grid
pred_data <- expand.grid(
  # Hold time steady at the midpoint (0.5) to see the pure effect of severity
  time_std = 0.5, 
  # Let severity vary across the full observed range
  severity_total = seq(min(sample_10$severity_total, na.rm = TRUE), 
                       max(sample_10$severity_total, na.rm = TRUE), 
                       length.out = 100),
  gender = levels(sample_10$gender)
)

# 2. Generate Predictions
preds <- predict(bams$F0, newdata = pred_data, se.fit = TRUE)
pred_data$fit <- preds$fit
pred_data$se  <- preds$se.fit

# 3. Plot: F0 vs Severity Total
ggplot(pred_data, aes(x = severity_total, y = fit, color = gender, fill = gender)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = fit - 2*se, ymax = fit + 2*se), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  # Separate by gender for clearer comparison of the slopes
  facet_wrap(~gender) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of Disease Severity on F0",
    subtitle = "Predictions held at median recording time (time_std = 0.5)",
    x = "Severity Total (MDS-UPDRS)",
    y = "Predicted F0 (Hz)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
#for this one it didn't generate because it said the graph margins are too large 
```
